2607.01766.title: SimWorlds: A Multi-Agent System for Dynamic 3D Scene Creation
2607.01766.paper_summary: LLM agents are increasingly used to translate natural language into 3D scenes in a procedural way, but existing systems focus on static output. Dynamic 4D scenes from text alone, in which liquids flow, particles emit, rigid bodies cascade, and articulated mechanisms move, remain largely unexplored despite their value as editable content and as physics-grounded training data for video generation and embodied AI. Two challenges set the dynamic case apart from static text-to-scene work: an agent must jointly coordinate spatial layout, multiple physics solvers, temporal sequencing, camera, and lighting in a single coherent scene, and verifying motion correctness from rendered video is fundamentally harder than judging a single image. We present SimWorlds: a multi-agent framework that produces dynamic, editable 4D scenes from text, with Blender-specific procedural knowledge, a planner-coder-reviewer workflow driving a fixed ordered sequence of construction stages, a layered scene protocol enforced by a deterministic verifier, and a runtime-state inspection tool suite that catches mechanism failures the rendered image cannot reveal. We also introduce 4DBuildBench, a benchmark for assessing both visual fidelity and physical consistency of the procedural dynamic 3D scenes generated from text prompts. Experiments show that SimWorlds outperforms prior dynamic Blender generation baselines.
2607.01766.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理人越來越多地被用來以程序化的方式將自然語言轉換為 3D 場景，但現有系統專注於靜態輸出。僅從文本生成的動態 4D 場景，其中液體流動、粒子發射、剛體崩落和關節機構運動，儘管作為可編輯內容和基於物理的視頻生成及具身 AI 的訓練數據具有價值，但仍然在很大程度上未被探索。動態情況與靜態文本到場景工作的兩個挑戰不同：代理人必須在單一一致的場景中共同協調空間佈局、多個物理求解器、時間排序、相機和照明，並且從渲染視頻中驗證運動正確性在根本上比評估單一圖像更難。我們提出了 SimWorlds：一個多代理框架，能夠從文本生成動態、可編輯的 4D 場景，具有 Blender 特定的程序知識、一個驅動固定有序建構階段序列的計劃者-編碼者-審核者工作流程、一個由確定性驗證器強制執行的分層場景協議，以及一套運行時狀態檢查工具，能夠捕捉渲染圖像無法揭示的機構故障。我們還介紹了 4DBuildBench，一個基準，用於評估從文本提示生成的程序動態 3D 場景的視覺真實性和物理一致性。實驗顯示，SimWorlds 的表現超過了先前的動態 Blender 生成基準。
